text:
tess_sales: Heads-up: Prospect HarborBank requires a BYO-KEK POC for bank-grade PII. Must support HSM-held KEK, monthly rotation, dual-custody, and an attestation package for auditors. They also want a clear cost delta for per-HSM-call billing vs reserved Dedicated plan. Who can run the POC?

kai_se: I can run it. Questions: do they expect KMIP/TLS client auth? Need HSM endpoints (IPs/ports), expected QPS for crypto ops, and whether dual-custody means split-threshold or 2-party approval.

mira_gov: From compliance perspective: we need vendor + firmware version, FIPS level, attestation artifact format (signed manifest vs cert), and retention requirements for audit logs. Also confirm whether logs can be shared with auditors.

sam_ops: Note latency: direct HSM on hot path adds ~50ms p99 in eu-west; proxy-wrapping with short-lived tokens reduces calls but adds infra. Tradeoffs for cost + SLA.

tess_sales: HarborBank also asked about rotation incident SLA and whether fallback to platform KEK is allowed during recovery. Legal will only accept fallback if consented in SOW.

kai_se: Proposed minimal POC tests: 
```
1) Customer hands off KEK alias and ACLs
2) Wrap->unwrap sample payload and verify bilateral audit entries
3) Simulate monthly rotation and test app failover path to platform KEK for 30 min
4) Measure p99 latency for token generation with direct HSM vs proxy
```

mira_gov: Add requirement: signed attestation from vendor OR HSM manifest signed by customer's ops. Also require explicit no-export guarantee in writing.

sam_ops: I'll open ops ticket and mock cost scenarios based on QPS. ops_bot: Ticket created TICKET-4772 "HarborBank BYO-KEK POC" assigned to @kai_se. Draft runbook ETA 2025-04-10. https://redwood.example.com/t/TICKET-4772

tess_sales: Action items: 1) ask HarborBank for HSM IPs/ports, FIPS/vendor/firmware, QPS, and attestation format; 2) confirm dual-custody model; 3) provide pricing delta (hosted per-call vs Dedicated reserved). I'll follow up after legal sync. Thanks all :thumbsup:
